mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.5% over 3 months indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal housing sector contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with both RSAFS and HOUST declining, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing sector slowdown that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns during late-cycle contraction regimes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations that prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over 3 months indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential investment (RSAFS) above 700,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns during early-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with RSAFS > 700000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) signal broad economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with both INDPRO and GDPC1 declining, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.
